method: Source-match scoring follows blog-factcheck: 1.0 exact, 0.9 paraphrase, 0.5 weak exact example, null unverified. Score describes visible source match, not independent truth, universal applicability or causal proof. At most ten retained/cited source pages per article; linked original statistical sources checked separately within onboarding limit.
